newsitem.title: UK: Sedgwick to sell Aldgate House lease.
newsitem.headline: Sedgwick to sell Aldgate House lease.

text.p: Insurance broker Sedgwick Group Plc said on Thursday it is to sell its leasehold interest in Aldgate House for 19.5 million stg in cash.
The group's strategy is to dispose of any surplus assets and the proceeds are to be used for general corporate purposes, it said.
The Corporation of London which holds the freehold of the property is also selling its interest in the property.
Prior to the company's move to The Sedgwick centre in 1985, Aldgate House was its main London office building. It is now fully sublet to external tenants.
The deal is expected to be completed on February 11.
